question: Q-N-C1-D2
text: For the pickup borough with the lowest YoY % at 2024-06-30, the 10 pickup zones with the largest absolute YTD revenue decline.
interpretation: Pickup borough with the lowest YoY % at 2024-06-30 (NULL YoY excluded; ties: name); its 10 pickup zones with the largest absolute YTD revenue decline (YTD - STLY, most negative first; ties: location id).

fields.fieldCaption: Revenue YTD Same Time Last Year
Revenue YTD Same Time Last Year

assemble: WITH low AS (SELECT pickup_borough, yoy_pct FROM boroughs WHERE trips > 0 AND yoy_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY yoy_pct, pickup_borough LIMIT 1), ranked AS (SELECT z.pickup_borough AS borough, low.yoy_pct AS borough_yoy_pct, z.pu_location_id, z.zone, z.ytd_revenue, z.stly_ytd_revenue, COALESCE(z.ytd_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(z.stly_ytd_revenue, 0) AS revenue_change, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(z.ytd_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(z.stly_ytd_revenue, 0), z.pu_location_id) AS rank_no FROM zones z JOIN low ON low.pickup_borough = z.pickup_borough WHERE z.trips > 0) SELECT borough, borough_yoy_pct, rank_no, pu_location_id, zone, ytd_revenue, stly_ytd_revenue, revenue_change FROM ranked WHERE rank_no <= 10 ORDER BY rank_no
